answer: A farm of 394 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are logged in ledge, queued in ripple, and inlet publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 96 identities per epoch. A farm of 2972 identities would post 2963 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
